verdict.rationale: Asking whether a state business/lien registry can be driven headlessly, via an API or automated rail, is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only a credentialed web portal with Sign In / Create an Account and interactive filing and search flows. The probes show the main SOS front door and the DOR e-services sitting behind Radware Bot Manager CAPTCHA walls for keyless clients, which works against automation. The 'Data and Image Subscriptions' listing is an adjacent bulk-data offering with no documented programmatic or CI-capable interface, so it earns no credit.
